name: legal_reasoning_causality_legal_bench
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating models on causal reasoning within legal texts: tasks require identifying causal relationships, attributing causes, and reasoning about legal outcomes conditioned on causal facts. It measures a model's ability to extract and reason about causal structure in legal language and to select or generate correct causal attributions under legal scenarios.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face used in legal NLP and causal-reasoning evaluation, with limited but growing use among specialized researchers.
